project.name: 压力测试工作台
project.designRead: dashboard / security engineers / restrained-utility / medium-density / avoid-card-wall

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: Library --bg-brand #32F08C green for primary CTA and active states

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: radius 4-8 for cards/buttons, radius-full for tags; border-neutral-l1 for chrome
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: SF Pro / SF Pro Text body, JetBrains Mono code; heading scale 3xs-3xl; body-sm (11px) for labels, body-base (13px) for main text
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: spacer-12 (12px) for card padding, spacer-16 (16px) for section gaps, spacer-24 (24px) for page margin
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: dark surface layering bg-base-default → bg-base-secondary → bg-base-tertiary; bordered cards with subtle surface lifts; green brand accent sparingly
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: static surfaces use border + bg-overlay tints; shadow only for modals/dialogs
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: 2px stroke SVG icons from nimbus icon set; data-icon attribute for icon rendering
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: hover: bg-overlay-l2 lift; focus-visible: ring accent; active: bg-overlay-l3

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: left sidebar (240px), dark bg with green accent nav items; top bar with page title + status badge
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: SF Pro / SF Pro Text; headings use heading-sm (16px) to heading-md (20px); body uses body-sm (11px) to body-base (13px)
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: bg-base-default (canvas) → bg-base-secondary (cards) → bg-base-tertiary (raised); border-neutral-l1 for all chrome
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: brand green button for primary action; secondary ghost/outline for lesser actions
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: left-edge alignment for forms and lists; right-edge for status badges; center for empty states

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Dark dashboard for pressure-testing workbench. TRAE design system: green brand accent (#32F08C), deep dark surfaces, restrained borders, SF Pro typography. Density reduced by 30% vs original via progressive disclosure, fewer concurrent panels, and single-focus layout per page.

productContext.productType: 压力测试安全工具工作台

pages.title: 流程总览
pages.visualNorthStar: Single-CTA dashboard hero with compact 4-step progress bar — users immediately understand where they are and what to do next
pages.compositionPattern: Hero intro + inline workflow status bar + collapsible boundary card

componentPlan.why: KPI summaries for each workflow step
Status indicators (未开始/进行中/已完成)

pages.title: 攻击资源获取
pages.visualNorthStar: Protocol selector + single-column focused task form — collapsed advanced options reduce visual noise, empty states guide first-time users
pages.compositionPattern: Protocol tabs + core form + results panel (empty state by default)

pages.title: 资源池
pages.visualNorthStar: Map+list split layout with dominant 2D geographic view — protocol tabs moved below map header, pending protocols visually de-emphasized
pages.compositionPattern: Geo map (60%) + resource list (40%) split with protocol selector

pages.title: 控制台
pages.visualNorthStar: Progressive 3-step configuration (target → protocol → confirm) with live telemetry side panel — form density reduced, scenario presets for quick start
pages.compositionPattern: Step form left (55%) + live monitor right (45%)

pages.title: 延迟监控
pages.visualNorthStar: Minimal two-tab interface (follow-console / manual-target) with dominant latency chart — reduces standalone page overhead, embeds quick latency snapshot
pages.compositionPattern: Target controls + latency chart (dominant) + trend cards

componentPlan.why: Follow console / Manual target mode switch
